title: Beyond six MCV/RDW classes: an exploratory cross-survey test of continuous red-cell interaction information
abstract: Continuous MCV/RDW interactions changed cross-survey weighted Brier loss by +0.000802 (joint PSU bootstrap95% [+0.000188,+0.001647]); incremental predictive improvement was not established. NHANES III to separately recruited NHANES2017-2018, adults20-65. Outcome is unadjusted low measured haemoglobin, not etiologic anemia diagnosis. No advantage over directly measuring haemoglobin is claimed. Previously explored surveys; not untouched confirmation.
